clean_source_blocks.text: Officials say a commuter train and a long-distance train collided on the outskirts of Jakarta on Monday.
At least four people were killed and dozens injured when two trains collided outside the Indonesian capital Jakarta on Monday.
At least four people have been killed and more than 30 injured after two trains collided on the outskirts of Indonesia's capital Jakarta, according to the rail company.

JAKARTA, Indonesia — One train slammed into another at a station outside Indonesia’s capital on Monday, killing at least four people, injuring dozens and leaving several trapped in a badly damaged car, officials said.
